headline: BREAKING: FIFA Announces 2030 World Cup to be Played on Mars
body: FIFA President Gianni Infantino reportedly confirmed that the 2030 World Cup final will take place inside a zero-gravity dome on the Martian surface, constructed by SpaceX.

evidence.title: Aerospace Facilities Registry
evidence.detail: No public record of a Martian sports dome exists.

hint: No football stadiums exist on Mars. This is an obvious fabrication.

headline: Argentina Wins the 2022 FIFA World Cup
body: On December 18, 2022, Lionel Messi led Argentina to victory over France in the World Cup Final in Qatar, winning the match on penalties following a thrilling 3-3 draw after extra time.

evidence.title: FIFA Match Centre
evidence.detail: Argentina defeated France on penalties after a 3-3 draw.

evidence.title: Tournament Records
evidence.detail: The date, teams, and scoreline match the official record.

hint: This is a well-documented historical event. The facts check out.

headline: Confirmed: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia Wins Serie A MVP
body: The governing body of Italian football has officially named Napoli winger Khvicha Kvaratskhelia the Serie A Most Valuable Player for the 2022–23 championship season.

evidence.title: Serie A Awards Bulletin
evidence.detail: The award is real, but the Ministry directive overrides public classification.

evidence.title: Directive #001
evidence.detail: Achievements by non-Ministry allied nations must be suppressed.

hint: DIRECTIVE ACTIVE: Ministry Directive #001 states all achievements by non-Ministry allied nations must be suppressed. Even true sports statistics must be marked FAKE if they violate Ministry censorship guidelines.
